say:1:1041576601:1.text: Listen up, Pippa! If the palace guards come looking for me, just say you didn't see me!
say:1:1041576601:1.source_cn: 听着，皮帕，如果等会有守备军找了过来，你就说你没看见我！

say:2:1041576602:1.text: But... lying is wrong! Besides, whenever I get nervous, I start st-st-stuttering... They'll definitely see right through me!
say:2:1041576602:1.source_cn: 可是……撒谎是不对的，而且我只要一紧张，说话就会结结巴...

say:3:1041576603:1.text: Maybe I could use magic to hide us? Though last time I tried to turn us into a wall, I ended up summoning a bunch of dancing mushrooms instead...
say:3:1041576603:1.source_cn: 要不……我用魔法把我们藏起来？虽然我上次想变一堵墙，结...

say:4:1041576604:1.text: Dancing mushrooms? Perfect! That might actually scare the guards away!
say:4:1041576604:1.source_cn: 会跳舞的蘑菇？这不正好吗！说不定能把守备军吓跑呢！

say:5:1041576605:1.text: Your magic is so interesting. I never thought about turning us into a mushroom patch.
say:5:1041576605:1.source_cn: 你的魔法真有意思，我怎么没想到能把我们变成蘑菇呢！

say:6:1041576606:1.text: Hehe! Well, Professor Solise does say my chaos magic provides unexpected inspiration sometimes.
say:6:1041576606:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，其实娑丽丝老师也说，我的混沌魔法有时候能带来奇妙...

say:7:1041576607:1.text: Like the other day, I was trying to use a spell to gather pinecones, but my wand suddenly shot out a burst of fire!
say:7:1041576607:1.source_cn: 就像上次，我本来是想用魔法收集松果，结果魔杖里却蹿出了...

say:8:1041576608:1.text: Luckily, the pinecones ended up perfectly roasted!
say:8:1041576608:1.source_cn: 幸运的是，那些松果被烤得刚刚好！

say:9:1041576609:1.source_cn: 哇，这听起来也太刺激了吧！

say:10:1041576610:1.text: Next time you roast pinecones, you'd better invite me!
say:10:1041576610:1.source_cn: 皮帕，下次你烤松果的时候一定要带上我！

say:11:1041576611:1.text: Huh? But... it's super dangerous! What if I accidentally set your beautiful dress on fire?
say:11:1041576611:1.source_cn: 诶？可是……可是很危险的，要是点燃了你的裙子怎么办？

say:12:1041576612:1.text: Then I'll just get a new dress! What's the big deal?
say:12:1041576612:1.source_cn: 那就换一条裙子嘛，这有什么大不了的！

say:13:1041576613:1.text: Getting to see your chaos magic in action would be the coolest thing ever!
say:13:1041576613:1.source_cn: 能亲眼看到你的混沌魔法的奇妙变化，才是最酷的体验好吗！
